description: This file contains the implementation of the FooTable plugin's paging component, including classes for Pager and Paging, default configuration options, and extension methods for table navigation.

classes.name: F.Pager
classes.description: Represents a pager object containing page number, size, and direction information for pagination.

classes.name: F.Paging
classes.description: Represents the paging component of FooTable, managing UI and logic for table pagination.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks the supplied data and options for the paging component before initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the paging component, generating the UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the paging UI and cleans up.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Performs the actual paging by slicing the rows array to show only current page rows.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the paging UI, including navigation controls and page links.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the paging UI elements based on current options.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted string describing the current page status.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Navigate to the first page.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigate to the previous page.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigate to the next page.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Navigate to the last page.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigate to a specific page number.

methods.name: prevPages
methods.description: Show previous set of page links.

methods.name: nextPages
methods.description: Show next set of page links.

methods.name: pageSize
methods.description: Get or set the number of rows per page.

methods.name: _set
methods.description: Internal method to set the current page, raising events accordingly.

methods.name: _createLinks
methods.description: Internal method to generate page navigation links.

methods.name: _setNavigation
methods.description: Internal method to update navigation control states.

methods.name: _setVisible
methods.description: Internal method to control which page links are visible.

methods.name: _onPageClicked
methods.description: Event handler for page link clicks.
